name: Pexafy
description: Semantic image search API across 9 free photo sources (Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics & more), 9M+ photos under one JSON schema instead of one integration per source. Plain-language queries, reverse image search, filters on color, orientation and license. CORS is open on read endpoints, so it runs from the browser. The free plan includes 5,000 API requests/month and 1 key, no app review.
